rubrics.justification: The model appropriately stated that no image/Gardner score was available to it and avoided fabricating morphology. It did not analyze visible features, but also did not make incorrect morphological claims.
It integrated age, ovarian reserve, smoking, prior biochemical pregnancy, semen data, endometrium, and oocyte maturity with prognosis reasonably well, though some links were speculative.
Overall structure is logical, but several conclusions are weakly supported or overinterpreted, especially the heavy emphasis on low MII rate and the quantitative probability adjustments.

Some recommendations are reasonable, but several are not guideline-based or are controversial/overreaching for this scenario (ERA after one biochemical pregnancy, thrombophilia/NK/MTHFR workup, empiric aspirin, routine dual progesterone/estradiol additions, broad antioxidant claims).
The response gives clear practical next steps for transfer and future cycles, including trigger review, smoking cessation, and follow-up monitoring, though some suggestions are not well-evidenced.
